title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Unauthenticated verification mail amplification in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.3,…
description: The Joomla Visforms extension versions 1.0.0 through 5.6.3 and 6.0.0 through 6.2.0 contain a vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to trigger mass verification emails. This occurs because the verification mail task accepts arbitrary form IDs and recipients without any rate limiting, enabling mail amplification and excessive database entries.
